column1: # DoctKey acceptance fixtures — literal fallback (and smart off).
# Format: method,mode,smart,tone_style <TAB> keys <TAB> expected document text
# Priority is Vietnamese-first, like UniKey: keystrokes that spell a Vietnamese
# syllable become Vietnamese even when they also spell an English word. English
# survives only when the keystrokes cannot be Vietnamese.
# smart ON: words that cannot be Vietnamese fall back to the literal keystrokes
# smart ON: a final repeated operator must not eat a letter of an English word
# smart ON: a Vietnamese spelling always wins, exactly like UniKey
# ... and English is kept only when it cannot be Vietnamese
# UniKey's `w → ư` must not eat English: `sweet` gives the key back at once,
# `two` gives it back when the word ends (`ưo` only exists before a coda).
# smart ON: valid Vietnamese is kept (even if the keystrokes were accidental)
# smart OFF: the same keystrokes are always transformed
# VNI: an escaped word must not swallow following digits
